title: Prepending a bit to a written block
statement: Let $\sigma:\mathbb{N}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ be a bit sequence, let $i\in\mathbb{N}$, let $b$ be a bit, and let $\beta$ be a finite bit string. Writing $\beta$ starting at position $i+1$ in the sequence obtained from $\sigma$ by setting its bit at position $i$ to $b$ gives the same sequence as writing $b$ followed by $\beta$ starting at position $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $\sigma$ is a bit sequence indexed by the natural numbers
